connector.name: Korext: AI Code Governance
connector.registryDescription: Governance copilot for AI-assisted coding. 72 packs, 532 rules, proof bundles.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.korext.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package korext. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the korext account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
